title: a failed request holds ERROR while EN stays TRUE, EN FALSE clears it and STATUS keeps the code
note: COM-002 and docs/docs/runtime/communication-function-blocks.md: a request is made for a rising edge of EN; its result is held while EN stays TRUE and cleared when EN falls, and STATUS keeps the code of the last request until the next one starts. The native runtime of the conformance suite has no handler for the block, so the request fails at once with STATUS 3 (no handler): the case executes the ERROR half of the handshake, in the same scan as the edge, with no BUSY.
